t: A six hour unit where students build a paper piano and code it.
steps: Get the Paper Piano unit PDF.
Gather a micro:bit kit for each student.
Gather cardstock, copper tape or foil, and glue sticks.
Review micro:bit programming, binary conversion, and the C major scale.
Open MakeCode in a browser and test the first program.
Build one paper piano yourself before class.
Plan about 6 hours across several class periods.
